description: Generic code-boundary scenarios for offline Pass B taxonomy prompt checks. Not derived from the 40-case quality benchmark.

scenarios.description: Distinguish a stored key that conflicts with the best-supported answer from a plausible stored answer that evidence merely fails to substantiate.
Distinguish a single incorrect stored key from a case where more than the required number of options are reasonably defensible.
required_prompt_phrases: More than the required number of options are reasonably defensible

scenarios.description: Distinguish absent explanation from an explanation that exists but does not justify the answer or reject distractors.
required_prompt_phrases: does not adequately justify the answer

scenarios.description: Distinguish distractor-quality defects from answer-key correctness defects.
